title: Ramp hero
description: A left-aligned light hero over a faint dot grid: a small uppercase eyebrow with a live, ticking mono counter in a grey chip, a huge single-weight headline, a grey subline, an email bar with an acid-lime button, and a wide 12px-rounded product frame below. Everything rises in on load in a quick stagger.
notes: media fills the product frame (square on phones, 1310×584 on desktop); empty, it shows a plain grey placeholder
load-in is CSS; JavaScript only ticks the eyebrow counter
